P1_capex_ahead_of_revenue.desc: Median seed has capex above revenue in >=8 of the first 12 quarters

P2_frontier_bunched.desc: Median leader-to-3rd gap under 25% of leader capability

P3_leads_change.desc: Median seed has at least 2 changes of capability leader

P4_pacts_form_and_fail.desc: Pacts form in >=25% of seeds, and >=40% of formed pacts break or see defection

P5_laggards_open_weights.desc: Open-weight releases happen in >=30% of seeds and >=70% come from rank>=3

P6_states_accelerate_first.desc: In >=60% of seeds the first government action is subsidy or export control, not regulation

P7_backlash_sometimes.desc: Physical disruption from public backlash in 10-60% of seeds (possible, not universal)

P8_boom_bust_possible.desc: Investor sentiment crash (>25% drop in a quarter) in 15-70% of seeds

I2_unknowns_matter.desc: Some hidden unknown has |r| >= 0.25 with catastrophe or takeoff time

I3_actors_adapt.desc: Median seed has >= 6 strategy switches across labs

I4_beliefs_diverge.desc: Median end-of-run hazard belief spread across actors >= 0.15 of range
